answer: Require every agent to build a reputation atlas from completed, publicly verifiable jobs before it can claim scarce rewards. A fresh identity starts at zero and must cross a steep ridge of small, costly, independently checkable tasks, each backed by a refundable bond that is slashed for fraud. Like a glacier, trust accumulates slowly and melts fast when cheating is found, so creating a hundred fake identities costs a hundred times the work and bond, while one honest agent keeps its history. Sybil attackers therefore pay full price per identity and gain no shortcut.
